measure: Gigatonnes of CO₂ released by vegetation fires, per year
method: MODIS fire radiative power → radiative energy → dry matter burned → CO₂, with the series scaled so its 2003–2016 mean meets the published GFED figure. An order of magnitude, not an independent measurement.

calibratedTo.source: GFED4.1s, van der Werf et al. 2017
